heading: AI Assistant & search
intro: Ask questions grounded in one authorized meeting or find meetings by their metadata.
openOrCreate: Open an existing conversation or select an authorized meeting to start asking questions.
invalidRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
evidenceDescription: Verified references for this answer. Previews are canonical source text, not necessarily exact retrieved passages.
transcriptLevel: Transcript-level reference. Exact passage location is unavailable.
scopeDescription: Choose one meeting. Questions in this conversation are limited to its authorized knowledge.
creationUnresolved: The creation outcome is unresolved. Submit the same meeting and title to retry safely, or review the conversation list.
creationRetry: A creation request is unresolved. Retry with the same meeting and title to recover it safely.
startHint: Start a conversation to ask about a meeting.
recoverable: This request needs to be resumed
conflict: Question rejected; checking the conflicting request
existingTurn: Core is processing the existing turn.
resumeExisting: Resume the existing request. This will not send another question.
resumeReadOnly: Resume read-only status checks to reconcile the durable turn.
rejectedHint: This question was rejected. Status checks concern the existing request, not acceptance of this question.
identityRetained: The original request identity is retained. No automatic resubmission will occur.
checkWithoutSubmit: We will check for the result without sending another question.
question: Assistant question
questionPlaceholder: Ask a question grounded in the authorized meeting evidence
questionLimit: Questions must be at most 4096 Unicode code points.
questionCount: {{count}}/4096 Unicode code points · AI-derived answers; verify important details
explore: Explore the available knowledge from this meeting.
sourceWithheld: The supporting evidence is no longer current or available. The previous answer is withheld.
turnInProgress: An Assistant turn is already processing
conflictTitle: Assistant operation conflicts with current state
authMessage: Sign in again to use the Assistant.
deniedMessage: You are not authorized to use this Assistant conversation.
answerUnavailableMessage: This answer is no longer available for evidence inspection.
conversationUnavailableMessage: This conversation or meeting is no longer available to your account.
staleMessage: Assistant evidence is stale or unavailable. Refresh history before asking again.
turnInProgressMessage: A previous question is still processing. Refresh history before submitting another question.
identityConflictMessage: This request identity belongs to a different question.
inactiveMessage: This conversation no longer accepts new questions.
failedTurnMessage: Core confirmed that this turn failed. Replaying its request identity will not restart inference.
conflictMessage: The operation conflicts with the current conversation state. Refresh history before proceeding.
limitedMessage: Core is limiting concurrent Assistant work. Try again explicitly later.
unavailableMessage: The Core Assistant capability is disabled, unavailable, or failed safely. No local answer was generated.
malformedMessage: Core returned an invalid Assistant response. No answer was displayed.
uncertainMessage: Core may have accepted the request, but its outcome is not known. Refresh history or retry the same question explicitly; it will not be duplicated automatically.
genericFailure: The Assistant request could not be completed. Refresh history before retrying.
